---
title: "About"
---

Hi, I’m Apoorva.

I’m a mechanical engineering PhD student interested in soft robotics, reservoir computing, neuromorphic systems, sensing, 
and control.

A lot of my work sits at the intersection of physical systems and computation: how bodies move, how materials respond, 
how dynamics process information, and how robots can use these ideas to sense and act.

**The Curious Notebook** is where I collect small simulations, technical notes, and ideas I am trying to understand more 
deeply.

Some pages are polished. Some are exploratory. The goal is to make the process of understanding visible without 
pretending every idea is finished.
